source_contract.transport: GitHub REST API over HTTPS and Git object reads only

credential_scope.required: read-only repository metadata and contents access to OscarMackJr/bluto; read-only Actions metadata and security configuration access only where the selected endpoint requires it
prohibited: write, administration, workflow dispatch, deployment, secret access, token creation, issue or pull-request mutation

target_validation.rule: Before any source request, resolve the supplied repository and commit. The collector must stop without an evidence record unless both equal the scope repository and immutable_repository_revision exactly.
target_validation.repository_content_rule: Every repository-content source must be requested with ref=7d3e12a2f7804041efd2840268f4d3d46f4266f9. Returned object SHA values and the resolved commit identity must be retained in provenance.
target_validation.live_configuration_rule: Repository configuration endpoints describe the observation-time configuration, not historical commit state. Their provenance must include target revision, request URI, response ETag when supplied, and collected_at_utc; they are valid only when collected_at_utc is no more than 15 minutes before the evidence record is sealed.

projection: CODEOWNERS blob SHA and UTF-8 content
active rulesets whose target includes tag refs
workflow file blob SHA and UTF-8 content
template blob SHA and UTF-8 content
SECURITY.md blob SHA and UTF-8 content
license file blob SHA and UTF-8 content
workflow file blob SHA and UTF-8 content

collector_and_payload_contract.canonicalization: Serialize the evidence record excluding canonical_payload_sha256 as UTF-8 JSON using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme; canonical_payload_sha256 is the lowercase SHA-256 of those canonical bytes.
collector_and_payload_contract.traceability_rule: Each record contains exactly one control_id and target tuple. It must reference every source URI used, each source object SHA when content is repository-bound, and the collector version.

failure_and_result_binding_contract.result_mapping: No fail-closed collection condition may be mapped to PASS or FAIL. Only a later, separately authorized evaluator may map a schema-valid evidence record to an assessment result.
failure_and_result_binding_contract.persistence_boundary: Evidence records may be persisted only after a separately approved contract publication and collector implementation/readiness gate. Until then this candidate permits neither collection nor persistence.

if_approved: authorizes publication of this exact D5 contract candidate after normal protected-branch checks
authorizes subsequent bounded collector implementation and static readiness work only
